register.labelZh: CHECK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 你可以用 check into 表示辦理酒店入住、用 check somebody in 表示替某人登記、用 check bagsin 表示託運行李,以及用 check out 表示離開前辦理退房。；check out 和 check up on 能幫助你在信任公司、聘用某人或相信一個說法前先作調查。；你可以 check work over、check through a report,並把已完成的工作 check off a list。；check out 可以表示在店舖付款,也可以表示從圖書館借閱或借用物品;整個情境會顯示所指的意思。
register.summaryEn: You can check into a hotel, check somebody in at an event, check bags in at an airport and check out before leaving. Check out and check up on help you investigate before you trust a company, employ somebody or believe a story. You can check work over, check through a report and check finished jobs off a list. Check out may describe paying in a shop or borrowing an item from a library. The situation shows which meaning is intended.

questions.answerZh: 我們把小袋留在身邊,但辦理了兩個大行李箱的託運。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 在機場等地方交出行李辦理託運

questions.prompt: The hotel was still noisy after midnight, so Chloe paid and left earlier than planned.
questions.promptZh: 酒店過了午夜仍很嘈吵,所以克洛伊付清帳單後提早離開。
questions.answer: The hotel was still noisy after midnight, so Chloe checked out earlier than planned.
questions.answerZh: 酒店過了午夜仍很嘈吵,所以克洛伊提早辦理退房。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 辦理退房或提早離開

questions.prompt: When the new history books arrived, students were allowed to borrow them for one week.
questions.promptZh: 新歷史書送到後,學生可以借閱一星期。
questions.answer: When the new history books arrived, students were allowed to check them out for one week.
questions.answerZh: 新歷史書送到後,學生可以借閱一星期。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 從圖書館等地方借閱或借用物品

questions.prompt: The offer looked excellent, but we investigated the company before sending any money.
questions.promptZh: 這項優惠看來很好,但我們在付款前先調查了這間公司。
questions.answer: The offer looked excellent, but we checked the company out before sending any money.
questions.answerZh: 這項優惠看來很好,但我們在付款前先調查了這間公司。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 在作決定前調查或核實某事物

questions.prompt: Leo explained what happened, and later every detail was found to be correct.
questions.promptZh: 里奧解釋了事情經過,後來每個細節都證明正確。
questions.answer: Leo explained what happened, and later every detail checked out.
questions.answerZh: 里奧解釋了事情經過,後來每個細節經查證後都正確。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 經查證後證明屬實或正確

questions.prompt: The laptop worked again, but the repair worker examined it carefully before returning it.
questions.promptZh: 手提電腦恢復運作,但維修人員交還前仍仔細檢查了它。
questions.answer: The laptop worked again, but the repair worker checked it over carefully before returning it.
questions.answerZh: 手提電腦恢復運作,但維修人員交還前仍仔細檢查了它。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 仔細檢查某事物,看看是否有問題

questions.prompt: We had planned six jobs for the morning. By noon, we had marked all six as finished.
questions.promptZh: 我們早上安排了六項工作。到了中午,我們已把六項全部標示為完成。
questions.answer: We had planned six jobs for the morning. By noon, we had checked all six off.
questions.answerZh: 我們早上安排了六項工作。到了中午,我們已把六項全部劃去。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 在清單上把已完成或已確認的項目劃去

questions.answer: Could you check this suitcase in while I keep the small bag with me?

questions.prompt: I needed the book for one night only, so I borrowed it and returned it the next morning.
